 Follow Us On: News Entertainment OTT Ananya Panday's phone calls on KWK 9 leave Ananya Birla joking about her exes Ananya Panday's phone calls on KWK 9 leave Ananya Birla joking about her exes
 Ananya Panday calls Aditya Roy Kapur, Ishaan Khatter and Kartik Aaryan in the latest Koffee with Karan 9 promo. Ananya Birla jokes that the calls cover all her exes, while Shanaya Kapoor makes a surprise appearance.
 Advertisement Ananya Birla teases Ananya Panday as she calls her exes on Koffee with Karan 9 (Photo: JioHotstar promo) By: India Today Entertainment Desk New Delhi , Nov 14, 2026 19:44 IST Last Updated Nov 14, 2026 19:44 IST Published by Anisha Rao Nov 14, 2026 19:00 IST Actor Ananya Panday seems to have a few phone calls to make, and Karan Johar is only too happy to let the cameras roll. The latest promo for Koffee with Karan Season 9 shows the actor calling Aditya Roy Kapur, Ishaan Khatter and Kartik Aaryan, leaving co-guest and businesswoman Ananya Birla amused enough to point out that she's called all her exes. Now that's one way to spice up a Koffee date!
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Hosted by Karan, the upcoming episode brings Ananya Panday and Ananya Birla together for a mix of cheeky questions, games and personal revelations. Shanaya Kapoor also makes a surprise appearance, adding to the fun.
 The fun begins with Ananya Panday declaring that she hates every other Ananya in the world, except singer Ananya Birla. The two then get into a round of 'Sip It If You've Done It', where Birla reveals that she once had an entire venue cleared for a private date.
 But it's Ananya Panday's phone calls that steal the show. She picks up the phone and calls Aditya, Ishaan and Kartik, prompting Birla to joke that she's dialled all her exes. Whether the three calls lead to any interesting conversations is something viewers will have to wait and watch.
 Watch the promo here: View this post on Instagram A post shared by Karan Johar (@karanjohar) Shanaya Kapoor joins the fun
 Bollywood actor Ananya's close friend Shanaya Kapoor also makes a surprise appearance and joins the girls for a rather cheeky challenge. She's asked to come up with a line that could work both in a boardroom and a bedroom. Ananya and Shanaya also find common ground over their admiration for Ranveer Singh.
 Birla, meanwhile, gets asked about the most 'un-Birla' thing about her. Her answer? She never carries money with her. Quite an unexpected confession, given the family name! Ananya's past Koffee conversations
 Ananya's phone calls are bound to remind viewers of her previous appearance on the show in Season 8, when she appeared alongside Sara Ali Khan. Karan had brought up their shared history with Kartik Aaryan and asked Sara about staying friends with an ex.
 He also tried to get Ananya to open up about her equation with Aditya. When asked if she was in the friend zone with him, she replied, "Not friends. We're friends." Karan then quipped, "Love is friendship," to which Ananya insisted that they were best friends.
 The new episode of Koffee with Karan Season 9 will stream exclusively on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar. - Ends ALSO READ | Ananya Panday is Geet from Jab We Met, says 'used to burn pictures of ex'
